name: live_reset
sql: update publish_watch.config set dry_run = false, label = 'TEST (TEN-347 install check)', stale_after = interval '24 hours'; delete from publish_watch.checks; delete from publish_watch.messages; update publish_watch.state set condition = 'ok', since = now(), owed_kind = null, owed_text = null; select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: fresh_1
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: fresh_2
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: fresh_3
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: fresh_assert
sql: do $$ begin if (select count(*) from publish_watch.checks where built_at is not null) < 2 then raise exception 'fresh control read no build-info'; end if; if exists (select 1 from publish_watch.messages) then raise exception 'fresh control SENT a message'; end if; end $$; select count(*) filter (where built_at is not null) as good_reads, count(*) as checks, (select count(*) from publish_watch.messages) as messages from publish_watch.checks

name: force_stale
sql: update publish_watch.config set stale_after = interval '1 minute'; select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: stale_1
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: stale_2
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: stale_3
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: stale_4
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: stale_assert
sql: do $$ begin if (select condition from publish_watch.state) <> 'stale' then raise exception 'not stale: %', (select condition from publish_watch.state); end if; if (select count(*) from publish_watch.messages where kind = 'alert' and delivery = 'sent') <> 1 then raise exception 'alert not delivered exactly once: %', (select string_agg(delivery, ', ') from publish_watch.messages); end if; end $$; select id, kind, delivery, created_at from publish_watch.messages order by id

name: force_fresh
sql: update publish_watch.config set stale_after = interval '24 hours'; select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: rec_1
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: rec_2
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: rec_3
sql: select publish_watch.tick() as r

name: recovery_assert
sql: do $$ begin if (select condition from publish_watch.state) <> 'ok' then raise exception 'not recovered'; end if; if (select count(*) from publish_watch.messages where kind = 'recovery' and delivery = 'sent') <> 1 then raise exception 'recovery not delivered exactly once: %', (select string_agg(kind || '=' || delivery, ', ') from publish_watch.messages); end if; if (select count(*) from publish_watch.messages where delivery in ('sent', 'queued')) <> 2 then raise exception 'extra messages: %', (select string_agg(kind || '=' || delivery, ', ') from publish_watch.messages); end if; end $$; select id, kind, delivery, created_at, text from publish_watch.messages order by id

name: arm
sql: update publish_watch.config set label = null, stale_after = interval '30 minutes', dry_run = false; update publish_watch.state set condition = 'ok', since = now(), owed_kind = null, owed_text = null; select cron.schedule('ten347_publish_watch', '* * * * *', 'select publish_watch.tick()') as jobid

name: status
sql: select s.condition, s.since, s.owed_kind, c.stale_after, c.label, c.dry_run, j.schedule, j.active from publish_watch.state s, publish_watch.config c, cron.job j where j.jobname = 'ten347_publish_watch'

name: last_checks
sql: select id, fired_at, status_code, built_at, commit_sha, cache_age_s, error from publish_watch.checks order by fired_at desc limit 5

name: messages
sql: select id, kind, delivery, created_at, text from publish_watch.messages order by id

name: neighbours
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job order by jobname
